source: Samsung Microwave Oven Service Manual (ME16A4021A* / ME16K3000A*, July 2022)
content: If the oven operates with the door open 1. Instruct the user not to operate the oven and contact the manufacturer and the center for devices and radiological health immediately. 2. Instruct owner not to use oven until it has been brought into compliance.
